definitions.gloss: study book; learning guide; educational workbook
definitions.explanation: A book designed for self-study or supplementary learning on a particular subject, typically containing explanations, exercises, and practice problems. Distinguished from classroom textbooks by being geared toward independent study.

examples.japanese: {漢字|かんじ}の{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a kanji study book.

examples.japanese: この{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}は{初心者|しょしんしゃ}にも{分|わ}かりやすい。
examples.english: This study book is easy to understand even for beginners.

examples.japanese: {書店|しょてん}の{語学|ごがく}コーナーには{英語|えいご}の{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}が{数多|かずおお}く{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Numerous English study books line the language section of the bookstore.

notes:
Compound of {学習|がくしゅう} ('study; learning') and {書|しょ} ('book; written work'). The suffix {書|しょ} forms many book-type compounds: {参考書|さんこうしょ} ('reference book'), {教科書|きょうかしょ} ('textbook'), {辞書|じしょ} ('dictionary').

USAGE:
- Common in bookstores, where sections are labeled by type: {学習書|がくしゅうしょ}, {参考書|さんこうしょ}, {問題集|もんだいしゅう} ('problem sets').
- Covers a wide range from children's workbooks to adult self-study guides on languages, qualifications, and professional skills.
- More formal than ドリル ('drill book') or テキスト ('text'), but less formal than {学術書|がくじゅつしょ} ('academic publication').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語学|ごがく}{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}: language study book
- {漢字|かんじ}{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}: kanji study book
- {学習書|がくしゅうしょ}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose a study book
- {学習書|がくしゅうしょ}コーナー: study book section (in a bookstore)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {教科書|きょうかしょ}: textbook — the official book used in school classes, as opposed to supplementary study material
- {参考書|さんこうしょ}: reference book; study aid — supplementary material for exam preparation
- {問題集|もんだいしゅう}: problem collection; workbook — focused on practice exercises and questions
- テキスト: text; textbook — loanword used casually for any study material, especially in language schools
